integrity: Analytical proof plus independently executable rational finite-state checks. General qualitative positivity risk and optimal-control formula are credited to the 2025 predecessor. Full 2026 primary text was inaccessible; its possible uninspected overlap is disclosed. No independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Exact real four-row/two-direction orthonormal-column Galerkin example; independent fair Bernoulli sketching, two positive coefficient levels, and population-optimal entrywise controls. Not a general FEM-mesh, empirical-control, floating-point, or solver-error theorem.
title: A sharp contrast–sample phase law for positivity of variance-optimal Bernoulli Galerkin control variates
